description: Tool contracts for the Research Discovery Genie Agent. Every retrieval tool is read-only; the only writing path creates PENDING_APPROVAL proposals and cannot mutate corpus or platform state.

tools.name: search_claims
tools.returns: Reviewed claims with claim_id, scope fields, evidence_excerpt, source_url, page_number, reviewed_at
tools.guarantee: Cannot return an unreviewed or superseded claim.

tools.name: compare_claims
tools.returns: comparability_status, comparability_score, missing_dimensions, both claim texts and values, verdict_note
tools.guarantee: Deterministic. The agent must call this before asserting agreement or disagreement.

tools.name: get_claim_evidence
tools.returns: Excerpt, originating chunk, parser and parser warning, source metadata, retrieval time, review decision
tools.guarantee: Provenance only; surfaces parser warnings so an answer can be qualified.

tools.name: get_open_questions
tools.guarantee: Every gap is derived from counted claims. The agent may not state a gap this did not return.

tools.name: get_corpus_coverage
tools.returns: Source counts, reviewed and unreviewed claim counts, parser-warning count, retrieval freshness
tools.guarantee: Used to qualify any consensus or coverage statement.

tools.name: create_proposal
tools.returns: Confirmation that a PENDING_APPROVAL record was created
tools.guarantee: Inserts status='PENDING_APPROVAL' only. Payload validation rejects any claim id that did not appear in this turn's tool output. No approval or execution path exists in this project.

explicitly_absent_tools: Any tool that approves a proposal
Any tool that changes a claim's review_status
Any tool that writes to research_claim, research_source or research_chunk
Any tool that grants permissions, deploys code, or calls an unapproved external API
